acceptance: The strongest test is not 'can the record be found?' — it is 'can a cold successor retrieve the relevant meaning, understand it, use it within authority and continue the work?'
definition: Memory is durable, retrievable meaning with enough context for correct future use.
one_brain_rule: Do not create another hidden store, graph or memory system merely because a canonical retrieval seam is inconvenient.
purpose: The memory doctrine of the activation kit: what memory must preserve, what useful retrieval explains, the one-brain rule, and the acceptance test.
title: INTELLIGENCE / MEMORY
